headline: PIT @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PIT 4.82 at TOR 3.67, with a projected total of 8.49. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PIT: PIT moved +0.69 runs while TOR moved -0.92, changing the projected margin by +1.61 runs. NRFI probability rose +12.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Paul Skenes has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jesús Sánchez, Nick Gonzales, Spencer Horwitz, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Kazuma Okamoto, Myles Straw because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
